race.comment: DOMINANT DARCY (10) sets up well for this third-up after just missing at Doomben, and also being close when resuming. Gets weight relief and reunites with her regular rider in Lang. GET READY LASS (8) looms as one of the main dangers. She was a brave track-and-trip winner two back, then showed grit again last time when holding onto second after racing wide throughout. With a more economical run this time she can return to winning ways. GOSPEL GIRL (4) has a trial to keep her ticking over after a tough run at the Gold Coast. Should be at her top now and is drawn to get all the favours. Not dismissing. MERCURIAL LADY (5) returns and is a noted fresh performer. Suspect she will be sweating on a gap to appear so she can burst through late.
